Headcount 1.1.2 needs Paper 26.3 and Java 25, like 1.1.0 and 1.1.1. Replace the jar and restart the server. Nothing in the database or the config files changes.

## What's fixed

- **The admin permissions work on their own.** `/hca` used to check `headcount.admin` before anything else, so a moderator given only `headcount.admin.audit` couldn't run `/hca audit`, and `headcount.admin.studio` couldn't be given without the rest. Now any one admin permission opens `/hca`, and each subcommand still checks its own. Players with none still don't see `/hca`.
- **Jails work on players in combat.** The combat tag blocks teleports by plugins, and that caught Headcount's own. A player jailed mid-fight got the message but stayed where they were, and one still tagged when their jail ended stayed in it for good. The jail, the release and the teleport action get through now.
- **A blocked command always says so.** Typing `/home` right after `/spawn` in combat was blocked without a word, because the PvP messages only held back repeats by type. Only the same message is held back now.
- **Studio keeps both backups** when a file is saved twice in the same second. The second one used to overwrite the first.

## Also new

- `/pvp status` tells a new player how long their new-player protection has left.
- Every 1.1 feature has bot tests now, on a server running Headcount with no other plugins: the included PvP, permissions, moderation and AFK, Studio, the resets, time zones and auto-switch.

## Upgrading from 1.1.1

There's one new message, `pvp.status-newbie`. It uses the default until you add it to your lang file.

The full list is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/TheMaydayMan/headcount/blob/main/Headcount/CHANGELOG.md).
